$comment: Hosted (flat) SynOI Decision Receipt versions: the exact signed-field list of each version, keyed by version, plus the hosted-v1.2 degraded_reason codes and integrity_grade enum. A verifier checks each receipt against exactly ONE entry: a receipt carrying schema_version uses the entry whose schema_version equals it, and an unknown value fails closed; a receipt without schema_version is unversioned legacy and tries unversioned_order (their canonical bytes are disjoint: hosted-v1.1 always signs a degraded key, hosted-v1.0 never does). Neither legacy entry signs schema_version, so stripping it from a hosted-v1.2 receipt makes the signature fail rather than verify as an older version. Field semantics are omit-when-absent: a field missing or null is left out of the canonical bytes, except required_fields (missing fails). degraded_rule: 'unsigned' = never signed; 'absent-is-false' = always signed as a boolean, absent signs false; 'required' = always signed as a boolean, absent fails. hosted-v1.0 and hosted-v1.1 are canonical-receipt-fields.json version 1 (that file is unchanged and still vendored as-is). Vendored by synoi-gateway src/receipt-version.ts and synoi-verify src/receipt-versions.ts, each with a drift test; synoi-control src/receipts/verify-signature.ts vendors the hosted-v1.2 additions. Read at TEST time only. Do not change a list here without updating every vendored copy in the same change. F2 (2026-10-31): six degraded_reason codes (trust_token_unverified folded into trust_token_absent, before any hosted-v1.2 receipt was in production), and hosted-v1.3: the hosted-v1.2 field set with grant_oid REQUIRED, emitted for receipts that carry a capability grant (A2A delegation); grant_oid stays optional in every earlier version. C1 (2026-11-01): hosted-v1.4, the approver-bound receipt: the hosted-v1.3 field list plus approver_oid, REQUIRED (grant_oid optional, ASSUMED), emitted for receipts that record a human approval decision by an authenticated enrolled operator. No earlier version signs approver_oid. refused_when_unsigned: a receipt carrying any of these fields under a version that does not sign it FAILS verification (it is not displayed with an UNSIGNED_FIELD warning), because a verifier must never accept a field set the signature did not cover.
canonicalization: The present, non-null signed fields as one JSON object, keys sorted, no whitespace, scalar values only (RFC 8785 JCS over scalars). degraded is a boolean.

field_notes.degraded: The computed value on every signing path, including the guard (/v1/risk/evaluate).
field_notes.integrity_grade: One of integrity_grades. A when degraded is false; otherwise the worst (alphabetically last) grade of the degraded_reason codes.
field_notes.degraded_reason: Present exactly when degraded is true: the distinct applicable degraded_reason_codes, sorted, comma-joined, no spaces.
field_notes.agent_id: Reserved for the agent registry. Absent when the gateway does not know the agent; signed when present. Non-empty string.
field_notes.owner_oid: Reserved for the agent registry: the agent's owner OID. Absent when unknown; signed when present. Non-empty string.

field_notes.grant_oid: Required: the OID of the capability grant the decision was made under (for an A2A delegation, the minted child grant). Non-empty string. A receipt without a grant is hosted-v1.2.

field_notes.approver_oid: Required: the enrolled operator OID ("oid-" + 64 lowercase hex: sha256 of the operator's enrolled public key, the same identity owner_oid uses) of the human who made the approval decision this receipt records (Desk spec v1 section 9). Signed only when the gateway authenticated that operator for the receipt's tenant; a receipt without an identified human approver keeps its earlier version.
field_notes.grant_oid: Optional, as in hosted-v1.2 (signed when present). ASSUMED: an approval receipt usually carries no capability grant.

integrity_grade_meanings.A: Not degraded: the code matches its build manifest and the control plane vouches for this install.
integrity_grade_meanings.B: The code matches its manifest, but nobody has vouched for it recently (no token, expired, or no clear status).
integrity_grade_meanings.C: The control plane flagged this install.
integrity_grade_meanings.D: The code does not match its manifest, there is no manifest, or the request was not governed (resilience bypass).
